question: How long do I have to work before I am entitled to paid vacation?
answer: За політикою оплачуваної відпустки (Paid Vacations), нові співробітники отримують право використовувати відпустку після 60 днів роботи в компанії. Самі години відпустки нараховуються (front loaded) на річницю працевлаштування, а їх обсяг залежить від стажу: 80 годин (0–3 роки), 120 годин (3–5 років), 160 годин (5+ років); для part-time — 40 годин. Невикористана відпустка не переноситься на наступний рік і не виплачується при звільненні.
expected_answer: New employees can use vacation after 60 days of employment.

question: How long do I have to work before I am entitled to paid vacation?
answer: You are entitled to 24 calendar days of paid annual leave after completing at least 6 months of continuous employment. During your first 6 months, vacation is pro-rated for the duration of employment. Some categories of employees (e.g., female employees before/after pregnancy and childbirth, employees with disabilities, employees hired following military service, etc.) are entitled to the full annual leave before the six-month period.
expected_answer: The full 24 days after 6 months of continuous employment; before that a pro-rated vacation (some categories get the full leave earlier).

question: How long do I have to work before I am entitled to paid vacation?
answer: You are entitled to 18 calendar days of paid annual leave after completing at least 50 weeks of continuous employment. During your first 50 weeks, vacation is pro-rated based on your length of employment. Some categories of employees (e.g., female employees before/after pregnancy and childbirth, employees with disabilities, employees whose wives are on maternity leave, employees hired following military service, and students using leave for exams/thesis) may be entitled to the full leave earlier. This applies to all It Company Costa Rica employees.
expected_answer: The full 18 days after 50 weeks of continuous employment; before that a pro-rated vacation (some categories get the full leave earlier).

question: What is the minimum amount of vacation I can take at once?
answer: Vacation may be used in minimum 4-hour increments. This applies to full-time and part-time employees under the Paid Vacations policy.
expected_answer: Vacation may be used in minimum 4-hour increments.

question: What is the minimum amount of vacation I can take at once?
answer: According to the Paid Vacation policy, annual leave may be divided into parts, but the main continuous part must be at least 14 calendar days. The second part can be requested in minimum 3-day increments. During martial law, vacation can be requested in minimum 1-day increments. So the minimum amount you can take at once is normally 3 calendar days, or 1 calendar day during martial law, provided the main continuous part is at least 14 calendar days.
expected_answer: The main part must be at least 14 calendar days, the rest in minimum 3-day increments; during martial law vacation can be taken in 1-day increments.

question: What is the minimum amount of vacation I can take at once?
answer: For employees in Costa Rica (IT-Outsourcing), if vacation is divided into parts, the main continuous part must be at least 14 calendar days, and the second part can be requested in minimum 3-day increments. So the minimum amount you can take at once is 3 calendar days (for the second part). Two weeks' notice is required before taking vacation leave.
expected_answer: The main part must be at least 14 calendar days, the rest in minimum 3-day increments (no martial-law exception).

question: Which public holidays does the company observe?
answer: It Company observes six paid holidays: New Year's Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day and Christmas Day. Holiday pay applies to full-time and part-time employees only (full-time: 1 day's pay; part-time: 4 hours' pay at the regular straight-time rate), and only if the employee is present at work on their last scheduled day before and first scheduled day after the holiday. Holidays are not paid to employees on any type of unpaid leave.
expected_answer: New Year's Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day, Christmas Day.

question: Which public holidays does the company observe?
answer: It Company observes six US holidays: New Year's Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day, and Christmas Day. In addition, employees receive 5 floating holidays that can be requested at their discretion to celebrate any Ukrainian public holidays. If a holiday falls on a Saturday or Sunday, it is observed the following Monday. Note the conditions: no more than 1 paid holiday day off can be taken in a 30-day period, and 4 days' notice is required before working on a paid holiday or taking paid days off. If you are required or wish to work on a paid holiday, you may take another paid day off instead.
expected_answer: Six US holidays (New Year, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas) plus 5 floating days for Ukrainian public holidays.

question: Which public holidays does the company observe?
answer: It Company observes six Costa Rican public holidays: New Year's Day (January 1), Juan Santamaría Day (April 11), Labour Day (May 1), Guanacaste Day (July 25), Independence Day (September 15), and Christmas Day (December 25). Employees also have 7 additional floating holidays. This applies to all employees in Costa Rica under IT-Outsourcing. If a holiday falls on Saturday or Sunday, it is observed the following Monday.
expected_answer: New Year's Day, Juan Santamaría Day, Labour Day, Guanacaste Day, Independence Day (September 15), Christmas Day.

question: How is sick leave paid?
answer: For employees who work in New York City, paid safe and sick time is paid at the same rate the employee earns at the time it is used, but no less than the applicable minimum wage. Payment is made no later than the payday for the next regular payroll period beginning after the safe and sick time was used. Safe and sick time is not considered hours worked for overtime calculations. Eligible NYC employees receive 40 hours of paid safe and sick time at the start of employment and each calendar year.
expected_answer: Employees working in New York City get 40 hours of paid safe and sick time per calendar year, paid at their regular rate; longer off-the-job illness — statutory short-term disability, 50% of average wages up to $170 a week from the 8th day.

question: How is sick leave paid?
answer: Sick leave is paid for up to 4 months if the illness or injury is confirmed by a medical sick leave certificate. The employer pays the first 5 days; the rest is paid by the Social Insurance Fund. The Fund’s payment depends on seniority: less than 6 months — based on minimum wage; 0–3 years — 50% of average salary; 3–5 years — 60%; 5–8 years — 70%; 8+ years — 100%. This applies to all employees in the UA IT-Product entity.
expected_answer: Up to 4 months with a medical certificate; the first 5 days are paid by the employer, the rest by the Social Insurance Fund at 50–100% of average salary depending on seniority.

question: How is sick leave paid?
answer: In Costa Rica (IT-Outsourcing, all employees), paid sick leave is available for up to four (4) months in case of illness or injury, provided it is confirmed by a sick leave certificate (or other standard form document) from the CCSS (Caja Costarricense de Seguro Social) or another medical institution. For the first three (3) days of sick leave, the employer pays 50% of the employee's salary; from the fourth day onward, the CCSS pays 60% of the employee's average salary.
expected_answer: For the first 3 days the employer pays 50% of salary; from the 4th day the CCSS pays 60% of average salary.

question: Скільки триває декретна відпустка і як вона оплачується?
answer: Окремої політики «декретної відпустки» у довіднику немає, але вагітність і догляд за дитиною регулюються двома політиками (для працівників у США/NY): 1) Statutory Short-Term Disability Benefits (3-15) — вагітність покривається: 6 тижнів після звичайних пологів і 8 тижнів після кесаревого розтину (може бути продовжено за ускладнень). Оплата — 50% середнього заробітку (за попередні 8 тижнів), максимум $170/тиждень; перші 7 днів — неоплачуваний період очікування; максимум 26 тижнів за 52 тижні. Заяву (DB-450) треба подати протягом 30 днів. 2) State Paid Family Leave (4-2) — до 12 тижнів за 52-тижневий період для зв'язку з дитиною протягом перших 12 місяців після народження/усиновлення; оплата — 67% середнього тижневого заробітку (до 67% середнього по штату). Право на PFL мають працівники зі звичайним графіком 20+ годин/тиждень і 26 послідовних тижнів стажу (або менше 20 годин і 175 відпрацьованих днів). Також є Prenatal Personal Leave (3-5) — 20 годин оплаченої відпустки на 52 тижні для медичних послуг, пов'язаних з вагітністю. За деталями зверніться до HR.
expected_answer: Statutory short-term disability: 6 тижнів після звичайних пологів (8 — після кесаревого), 50% середньої зарплати, до $170 на тиждень; плюс до 12 тижнів Paid Family Leave для догляду за дитиною (67% зарплати).

question: Скільки триває декретна відпустка і як вона оплачується?
answer: Декретна відпустка (відпустка у зв'язку з вагітністю та пологами) в Україні становить 126 оплачуваних календарних днів: 70 днів до орієнтовної дати пологів і 56 днів після народження дитини. Оплачується Фондом соціального страхування у розмірі 100% середньої заробітної плати працівниці. Право на таку відпустку мають вагітні співробітниці.
expected_answer: 126 календарних днів (70 до пологів і 56 після), 100% середньої зарплати від Фонду соціального страхування.

question: Скільки триває декретна відпустка і як вона оплачується?
answer: У Коста-Риці декретна відпустка триває 4 місяці: 1 місяць до очікуваної дати пологів і 3 місяці після народження дитини. Вона оплачується у розмірі 100% зарплати співробітниці: 50% сплачує роботодавець (It Company) і 50% — CCSS (Caja Costarricense de Seguro Social). Право застосовується до всіх вагітних співробітниць підрозділу IT-Outsourcing у Коста-Риці.
expected_answer: 4 місяці: 1 до пологів і 3 після; 100% зарплати — 50% платить роботодавець і 50% CCSS.

question: How many days of paternity leave do fathers get, and is it paid?
answer: The handbook does not provide a separate 'paternity leave' policy. Fathers may be eligible for New York State Paid Family Leave (PFL) to bond with a child during the first 12 months after birth, adoption, or foster care placement. Eligible employees can take up to 12 weeks (84 days) within a 52-consecutive-week period. PFL is partially paid: 67% of the employee's average weekly wage, up to 67% of the state average weekly wage. Eligibility requires a regular work schedule of 20+ hours per week and at least 26 consecutive weeks of employment, or fewer than 20 hours per week and at least 175 days worked. Employees must provide 30 days' advance notice when the need is foreseeable.
expected_answer: No separate paternity leave; Paid Family Leave gives up to 12 weeks to bond with a child, paid at 67% of the average weekly wage.

question: How many days of paternity leave do fathers get, and is it paid?

expected_answer: 2 weeks of unpaid leave; a father can also take over the mother's maternity leave if she has returned to work.

question: How many days of paternity leave do fathers get, and is it paid?
answer: Fathers are entitled to 8 days of paid leave for the birth of a child. Fathers may also acquire leave from the mother’s maternity leave if she has returned to work, subject to submitting a request and supporting documents.
expected_answer: 8 days of paid leave; a father can also take over the mother's maternity leave if she has returned to work.

question: Do I get a 13th-month salary?
answer: Yes. It Company Costa Rica office employees receive an annual 13th-month salary (aguinaldo) equal to one twelfth of the total salary earned from December 1 of the previous year to November 30 of the current year, and it is paid no later than December 20. In addition, regular pay is made twice a month: on the 15th for the first half of the month and on the last business day of the month for the second half.
expected_answer: Yes — the aguinaldo, one twelfth of the salary earned from December 1 to November 30, paid no later than December 20.
